QuestInfo.name: Monster Purge
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a special task for you, due to your past experience in monster extermination.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra will give you a special gift box for wiping out 300 monsters around your level.
QuestInfo.2: You wiped out 300 monsters for Cassandra and received a gift box. Do you really feel comfortable with fulfilling all of her grim whims?
